title: 第十五章 考核奖励第十六章 中大奖了
slug: 从巫师学徒到万界征服者
content_zh:
食堂早餐的供餐形式，类似自助。
但可供选择的菜品寥寥无几。
数量最多的，是堆积如小山般的面包，占据了一整张长桌，散发着刚出炉的、带着微焦气息的麦香。
而在餐台之后，是两尊静立不动的人形。
它们——是的，只能用“它们”来形容——由某种漆黑的、纹理细密的木材整体雕琢而成，关节处可见精巧的榫卯与金属加固。
它们的形体粗具人形，但面孔却是一片光滑的木纹，仅有几个凹陷勉强勾勒出眼、口的位置，表情是永远不变的木然。
这是巫术傀儡！
莫宁不由好奇地多看了两眼。
在广袤的巫术体系中，“傀儡学”是一个枝叶繁茂的庞大分支。
无数巫师穷尽一生，或许也只能在某个细分领域略有所得。
黑塔学院昂贵的付费课程列表中，同样并不缺少与傀儡相关的学科。
不同的傀儡，强弱天差地别。
弱小的傀儡仅能执行固定指令，从事清洁、搬运等杂役；
而传说中由大师制造的高阶战争傀儡，威能足以匹敌正式的巫师。
眼前这两尊，显然属于前者。
莫宁刚靠近取餐区域，其中一个静立的黑木傀儡，头颅便以一个略显生硬的角度转了过来。
一个平板、如同齿轮摩擦的机械音，自它口中传出：
“序列号7-118-256，莫宁。身份已确认，欢迎前来新人食堂就餐。”
它伸出雕刻出五指轮廓的木手，从旁边摞起的餐盘中精准拿起了一块。
几乎同时，另一个黑木傀儡同步启动，五根木指以令人眼花的速度，将几种食物有序地码放入餐盘内。

整个过程流畅、高效，没有一滴汤汁溅出，没有一丝多余的移动。
莫宁看得一眼不眨，心中暗暗做起了比较：“动作精度比前世先进的工业机械臂更高，似乎还具备一定的自主判断能力。”
他自然而然地将“巫术傀儡”列入了未来值得深入探究的领域清单。
寻常巫师受限于精力与天赋的边际，往往只能择一至两个主攻方向深挖。
但莫宁觉得，自己拥有【真理秘瞳】，未必不能成为精通多个领域的“全才”巫师。
他端起盛得满满当当的餐盘，走向食堂一个角落，在一张临着水墙的桌子旁坐下。
其他新人大多坐在角落里，这是弱者们共同的默契。
波光透过透明屏障，在他面前的木桌上缓缓流动，几条散发微光的透明小鱼正好奇地凑近，隔着“玻璃”与他对视。
莫宁先切下一小块烤呼噜兽肋排送入口中，细细咀嚼了两下，眉头微微蹙了一下。
肉质纤维粗糙，腥气比较重，香料与肉的本味格格不入，只能勉强入口。
巫师们对美食的热情，比他预想的还要低。
但昨天研究了一天秘法术数，脑力消耗巨大，强烈的饥饿感很快压倒了味觉上的挑剔。
他不再细品，开始狼吞虎咽。
莫宁拿起一块坚硬厚实的面包，咬下第一口，立即感受到了粗糙的麦麸。
他脑子里闪过一个念头：“如果将来我在学院拥有一定的话语权，第一件要改革的就是这该死的食堂。”
随着时间不断流逝，一位位新人脸带惊恐的进入了食堂。
食堂里没有多少人说话，所有人的脸色都不太好看。
进入学院的第一天，学院便给了新人们一个重重的下马威。
这似乎是在暗示——菜鸟们，想在学院里讨生活，没有你们想象得这么容易！
直到第四十八名新人出现时，终于诞生了第二位通过考核的人。

当然。
对新人们来说，这是“第一位”通过通过考核的人。
一个异常魁梧健硕的蓝袍身影，带着尚未平复的急促呼吸，大步流星的闯入了众人的视界。
此人环视全场，有点得意的问了一句：“伙计们，刚才我通过了考核，这里有人通过了吗？”
content_en:
The breakfast format in the cafeteria is similar to a buffet.
But there are very few dishes to choose from.
The largest amount was the mountain-like pile of bread, which occupied a whole long table and exuded the aroma of freshly baked wheat with a slightly burnt smell.
Behind the dining table are two human figures standing still.
They - yes, it can only be described as "they" - are made entirely of some kind of dark, fine-grained wood, with delicate mortise and tenon joints and metal reinforcements visible at the joints.
Their bodies are roughly humanoid, but their faces are made of smooth wood grain, with only a few depressions barely outlining the positions of their eyes and mouths, and their expressions are eternally dull.
It's a voodoo golem!
Mourning couldn't help but look at it curiously.
In the vast system of witchcraft, "puppetology" is a huge branch with flourishing branches.
Countless wizards spend their entire lives, and may only be able to gain a little bit in a certain niche field.
There is also no shortage of puppet-related subjects in the list of expensive paid courses at Black Tower Academy.
Different puppets have vastly different strengths and weaknesses.
Weak puppets can only carry out fixed instructions and perform chores such as cleaning and transportation;
The legendary high-level war puppets made by masters are powerful enough to rival official wizards.
The two figures in front of me obviously belong to the former.
As soon as Mourning approached the dining area, the head of one of the standing black wooden puppets turned at a slightly stiff angle.
A mechanical sound like a flat plate, like the friction of gears, came from its mouth:
"Serial number 7-118-256, Mourning. Identity confirmed. Welcome to the newcomer cafeteria."
It stretched out its wooden hand carved with five-finger outlines, and accurately picked up a piece from the dinner plates stacked next to it.
Almost at the same time, another black wooden puppet started simultaneously, and its five wooden fingers placed several kinds of food into the dinner plate in an orderly manner at a dizzying speed.
The whole process was smooth and efficient, without a drop of soup spilling or any unnecessary movement.
Mourning looked at it without blinking, and secretly made a comparison in his mind: "The movement accuracy is higher than the advanced industrial robotic arms in previous generations, and it seems to have a certain ability of independent judgment."
Naturally, he added "witchcraft golems" to his list of areas worthy of further exploration in the future.
Ordinary wizards are limited by their energy and talent, and can often only choose one or two main directions of attack.
But Mourning felt that with the [Secret Eye of Truth], he might not be unable to become an "all-rounder" wizard proficient in multiple fields.
He picked up the full plate, walked to a corner of the cafeteria, and sat down at a table facing the water wall.
Most of the other newcomers sat in the corner, which was a tacit understanding among the weak.
Waves of light passed through the transparent barrier and flowed slowly on the wooden table in front of him. Several small transparent fish emitting shimmering light were approaching curiously and looking at him through the "glass".
Mourning first cut off a small piece of grilled Snorlax ribs and put it into his mouth. He chewed it twice and frowned slightly.
The meat fiber is rough, the smell is relatively strong, and the spices are incompatible with the original flavor of the meat, so it can only be eaten reluctantly.
The wizards' enthusiasm for food was even lower than he expected.
But yesterday, I spent a day studying the secret spells, which consumed a lot of mental energy, and my strong hunger quickly overwhelmed my picky taste.
He stopped savoring it and started gobbling it down.
Moning picked up a piece of hard and thick bread, took the first bite, and immediately felt the rough wheat bran.
A thought flashed through his mind: "If I have a certain say in the college in the future, the first thing to reform is this damn cafeteria."
As time continued to pass, newcomers entered the cafeteria with frightened faces.
Not many people spoke in the cafeteria, and everyone looked unhappy.
On the first day after entering the college, the college gave the newcomers a heavy blow.
This seems to be a hint - rookies who want to make a living in the academy don't haveIt's so easy for you to imagine!
It was not until the forty-eighth newcomer appeared that the second person who passed the examination was finally born.
certainly.
For newcomers, this is the "first" person to pass the examination.
An unusually tall and muscular figure in blue robes, with rapid breathing that had not yet calmed down, strode into everyone's sight.
This person looked around the audience and asked a little proudly: "Guys, I just passed the assessment, has anyone here passed?"
